description: This is a PHP class file for the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically defining a controller for the 'Cheque' payment extension in the admin area. The class includes methods for displaying and saving the configuration settings for the cheque payment method.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Cheque payment method configuration in the Opencart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the Cheque payment method, loading necessary language files, models, and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the Cheque payment method settings, including permission checks and input validation, then returns a JSON response.
